data.longBusinessSummary: Oklo Inc. develops advanced fission power plants to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale to the customers in the United States. It also commercializes nuclear fuel recycling technology that converts nuclear waste into useable fuel for its reactors. Oklo Inc. has an joint agreement with newcleo to develop advanced fuel fabrication and manufacturing infrastructure in the United States. Oklo Inc. is based in Santa Clara, California.
